content: In this paper, we describe our experiments in finding out whether lemmatization helps modern contextualised embeddings (on the example of ELMo). We compare the performance of ELMo models trained on the same corpus before and after lemmatization. It is impossible to evaluate contextualised models on `static' tasks like lexical semantic similarity or word analogies. Because of this, we turned to word sense disambiguation in context (WSD) as an evaluation task.
